newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's KFA to seek 52,500T of corn on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's KFA to seek 52,500T of corn on Tuesday.

text.p: South Korea's Korea Feed Association (KFA) will invite a tender to buy 52,500 tonnes of corn by 11:30 a.m. (0230 GMT) on Tuesday, traders said on Monday.
Traders said arrival was set by October 5 to South Korea's western port of Inchon.
Shipment was slated for September 16-October 5 if sourced from China, for September 4-23 if from the Pacific Northwest or for August 15-September 3 if from the U.S. Gulf.
